label: SMASH DR2 · wider optical mosaic

footprint.kind: irregular union of observed DECam fields with detector gaps
footprint.scope: The extent is the survey-page description of the main-body field mosaic, not a solved WCS rectangle or guaranteed filled coverage. Black areas outside detector footprints are no-data, not measured zero light.

wcs.method: Match observed stars against our existing calibrated SMASH image/astronomical catalog and validate held-out matches. Do not fit the photo to the simulation morphology or derive exact WCS from approximate15x18.5extent.

image.dimensionPreservation: Original downloaded4111x5000pixels; no upscaling or image content alteration.1400px preview is only a review derivative.
image.color: Published three-color survey mosaic. Exact channel assignment/stretch not specified on source page; do not infer from2016HiPS.
image.previewSampling: Not yet astrometrically solved; cannot claim native~1arcsec resolving power for this5000px wide preview.

verification.content: Wider irregular field mosaic including outskirts, clearly distinct from the cropped9degree publicity photograph. Visible detector gaps and brightness transitions retained.
verification.noirlabCopyComparison: Independent1500x1824NOIRLab-hosted copy is the same wide scene. Resampled RGB correlations against author5000px file:0.99527,0.99526,0.99214.
verification.metadata: No EXIF, XMP or FITS WCS in downloaded JPEG.

license.status: Publicly distributed author/survey image with institutional credit; no image-specific machine-readable license found in JPEG/source page. Retain paper and official survey provenance; do not assign the arXiv manuscript license to the survey JPEG.

alternativeHips.reason: Properties report2016-12-02release, beforeDR2. Legacy source generation starts withSMC and concatenatesDR1-erafields; not evidence of fullDR2LMCcoverage.

processingStatus: Alignment preview acquired only. No star removal, decomposition, volume bake or recipe/UI mutation.
